StarDraft 2

A StarCraft creation suite for map and mod creators. Built by the community, for the community.

StarDraft 2 aims to be the spiritual successor to StarDraft, the 1998 editor by Camelot Systems that powered the StarCraft modding community of the early 2000s.

Download for Windows Join the Discord

Mac and Linux builds coming soon

Who it is for

Melee map makers

Paint terrain with brushes, spray, fill, replace and symmetry, or generate a full map. See the town area of each base, in HD, SD or Carbot graphics.

UMS & campaign makers

A modern classic trigger editor, unit, upgrade and technology settings, and mission briefings with preview. Campaign projects are coming soon.

EUD map makers

Edit unit, weapon, image and sprite data, and write triggers as blocks in plain sentences, or in your own epScript files. Checks find EUD errors and desyncs before you build.

Mod makers

Integrated mod editing: make maps with your custom mod files, and manage them in one place. For mods for both StarCraft: Remastered and 1.16.1.

Roadmap

Sourced from user reports and feedback.

Now

Add the missing features and quality-of-life improvements that users report.

  • Clickable build errors

    Click a build error in the Log to open its trigger and block in the Triggers workspace.

    #R0036 · EUD

  • Tiles in the map's graphics

    The Tiles list shows each tile in the graphics of the map: HD, SD or Carbot.

    #R0039 · Terrain

  • Preplaced unit graphics

    Preplaced units show the graphics from the map's data edits.

    #R0008 · EUD

  • Terrain rendering accuracy

    All tilesets look the same in StarDraft 2 as in the game, in HD, SD and Carbot.

    #R0002 · Terrain

  • More EUD trigger blocks

    Blocks for common mapping tasks: center the screen, queue buildings, play animations, place sprites, and sprite effects.

    #R0050 · EUD

Next

Make StarDraft 2 a more powerful creation suite.

  • Terrain decoration tools

    Tools that put doodads and decoration on the terrain, such as a doodad spray that puts doodads only where they fit.

    #R0037 · Terrain

  • Floating palettes

    Open each palette (terrain, tiles, units, doodads, sprites) as a floating window. Open several at once, each with its own filter.

    #R0040 · UI

  • Checker documentation

    Help for each EUD and desync check: the rule, an example, and what the check does not find. Each mark in the Triggers workspace links to its help.

    #R0038 · EUD

  • Unit range overlay

    Show the weapon ranges, sight, detection and psi fields of the selected units on the map.

    #R0033 · Capability

  • Terrain flag overlays

    Show on the map which terrain is walkable, how high it is, and which terrain gives cover or blocks the line of sight.

    #R0034 · Terrain

  • Fog of war preview

    Select a player, and see the fog of war of that player at the start of the game.

    #R0032 · Capability

  • Exact timers

    "After N seconds" and "Every N seconds" blocks that stay exact over a long game.

    #R0014 · EUD

  • Batch trigger generation

    Make many triggers from one pattern: one trigger for each player, location or unit type.

    #R0023 · UMS

  • Campaign projects

    Keep all the maps of a campaign in one project, in their order.

    #R0025 · UMS

  • Pathfinder region overlay

    Show the regions that units use to find their paths, to see why units take a path or get stuck.

    #R0035 · Terrain

  • Replay preview

    Make a replay of the map with computer players, and watch it in StarCraft.

    #R0031 · Capability

  • Map import from scmscx.com

    Find a map on scmscx.com, and open it in StarDraft 2.

    #R0042 · Capability

  • Revamped terrain generation

    Generate maps with a constraint-based method, such as wave function collapse: set rules for the terrain, and get maps that obey them.

    #R0049 · Terrain
